author: Konstantin Gredeskoul
description: Keeps a project's specifications, plans and pull requests joined up, and drives specialist agents over them in parallel. A feature's state is its folder name under .plans, so a transition renames a directory rather than updating a row, and nothing can claim a phase whose document is missing.
